How to add and use them

• Widget: long-press the home screen → Widgets → Moneo (expenses or income this month, switch with the tab)
• “Favourite entries” widget: large grid of buttons, a tap records the entry immediately
• Tile: pull down quick settings → edit → add “Voice entry” (works on the lock screen too)
• Shortcut: long-press the app icon
• Long-press + in the app opens the quick menu (voice entry, receipt scanner)

Notifications for recurring payments and the monthly summary. The app can also read bank notifications and offer payments for confirmation.

To offer payments for confirmation, Moneo needs notification access. Android grants it for all notifications, so the app can see their title and text. Moneo only looks for bank payments (amount and merchant), saves them as unconfirmed entries on this device and ignores everything else. Notification content never leaves the device and is not shared with anyone. You can revoke access anytime in system settings.
